name: Meadow Daisy

yarn.description: Cotton yarn for the sunny centre

gauge: Gauge is not critical; use a firm tension so the small centre is neat and the petals hold their shape.

steps.label: Rnd 1
steps.text: With yellow yarn, make an MR. Ch 1, which does not count as a st, work 6 sc in the MR; join with a sl st to the first sc.

steps.label: Rnd 2
steps.text: Ch 1, which does not count as a st, work 2 sc in each st around; join with a sl st to the first sc. Fasten off the yellow yarn.

steps.label: Petals
steps.text: Join white yarn with a sl st in any centre st. Make this petal sequence 6 times total: sl st in next centre st, ch 7, sc in second ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in each of next 3 ch, hdc in last ch; sl st in next centre st.

finishing: After the sixth petal, fasten off the white yarn, leaving a 10 cm tail.
Weave in all yarn tails on the reverse side, taking care not to pull the centre out of shape.
Lightly steam block the daisy and arrange the petals evenly. Let it dry completely.
notes: The petals are worked around the 12 stitches of the yellow centre; the white joining slip stitch is not a petal anchor.
